lemma_statement: theorem thetaOne_comp_kappaSlash (κ κ' : AnalyticWeight UK S ρ) (r : ℕ) (ν : UK →* Kˣ) (hκ : ∀ u : UK, κ.toChar u = (u : Kˣ) ^ ((r : ℤ) + 1) * ν u) (hκ' : ∀ u : UK, κ'.toChar u = (u : Kˣ) ^ (1 - (r : ℤ)) * ν u) (g : S) : (thetaOne K r).comp (κ.kappaSlash g) = ((g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K).det ^ r) • ((κ'.kappaSlash g).comp (thetaOne K r))
b2_reason: Hypotheses do not entail the conclusion: the common finite part nu is an unconstrained MonoidHom UK -> K^x, so its expansion nu(cz+d) need not be constant in z. Writing the slash action out, f|_kappa g (z) = kappa(cz+d)(cz+d)^{-2} f(gz), the r-th derivative of the left side produces an extra term c * (d/dz)[nu(cz+d)] * (lower-order), which the right side has no counterpart for. Buzzard's displayed identity (bu04.txt:1074-1090) carries no nebentypus factor at all: it is purely about (cz+d)^{k-2}. The repair is to delete nu, i.e. hkappa : kappa.toChar u = u^(r+1) and hkappa' : kappa'.toChar u = u^(1-r). That is the classical case Buzzard states, and it is what the LWX application needs, since the nebentypus there lives on the Iwahori level, not in kappa's expansion.
counterexample: r = 1; nu = the inclusion UK -> K^x; so kappa = (.)^3 and kappa' = (.)^1, both honest AnalyticWeights (polynomial expansions). Take g = (a b; c d) with c != 0 and f = 1 = cSpace.single 0 1. LHS: theta(f|_kappa g)(z) = d/dz[(cz+d)^{3-2} * 1] = c. RHS: det(g)^1 * ((theta f)|_{kappa'} g) = det(g) * (0 |_{kappa'} g) = 0. c != 0, so LHS != RHS.

lemma_statement: theorem thetaDisc_comp_discSlash (h r : ℕ) (κ κ' : AnalyticWeight UK (M1Kh h ψ) ρ) (ν : UK →* Kˣ) (hκ …) (hκ' …) (δ : M1 p) : (thetaDisc p K h r).comp (discSlash h ψ κ δ) = (ψ ((δ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℚ_[p]).det) ^ r) • ((discSlash h ψ κ' δ).comp (thetaDisc p K h r))
b2_reason: Inherits the T-AG1a defect verbatim: discSlash is a blockOp of kappaSlash, so the single-disc counterexample transports to any delta whose disc conjugate has c != 0. Same repair (drop nu).
counterexample: As T-AG1a, transported blockwise through discSlash.

lemma_statement: theorem thetaDisc_comp_discHeckeBlock (h r : ℕ) (κ κ' : AnalyticWeight UK (M1Kh h ψ) ρ) (ν : UK →* Kˣ) (hκ …) (hκ' …) … : (thetaDisc p K h r).comp (discHeckeBlock …) = (cst ^ r) • ((discHeckeBlock …).comp (thetaDisc p K h r))
b2_reason: Inherits the T-AG1a defect: discHeckeBlock is a sum of discSlash terms over coset representatives. Same repair (drop nu).
counterexample: As T-AG1a, summed over the coset decomposition.

lemma_statement: theorem thetaBlock_comp_discHeckeBlockOp (h r : ℕ) (κ κ' : AnalyticWeight UK (M1Kh h ψ) ρ) (ν : UK →* Kˣ) (hκ …) (hκ' …) … : (thetaBlock … h r).comp (discHeckeBlockOp …) = (cst ^ r) • ((discHeckeBlockOp …).comp (thetaBlock … h r))
b2_reason: Inherits the T-AG1a defect: this is T-AG2 assembled over the class set. Same repair (drop nu).

lemma_statement: theorem mem_locPolyDegSubmoduleBlock_discHeckeBlockOp (h k : ℕ) (κ κ' : AnalyticWeight UK (M1Kh h ψ) ρ) (ν : UK →* Kˣ) (hκ …) (hκ' …) … (hf : f ∈ locPolyDegSubmoduleBlock … h k) : discHeckeBlockOp … f ∈ locPolyDegSubmoduleBlock … h k
b2_reason: Independently false, not merely blocked: with nu = inclusion and r = k+1 the weight is kappa = (.)^{k+3}, so f|_kappa g = (cz+d)^{k+1} f(gz), which has degree k+1 for f of degree k. The classical subspace is then NOT stable. Same repair (drop nu), after which kappa = (.)^{k+2} and f|_kappa g = (cz+d)^k f(gz) has degree <= k.
counterexample: k = 0, nu = inclusion, so kappa = (.)^3; f = 1 has degree 0; f|_kappa g = (cz+d) has degree 1 > 0.

lemma_statement: theorem unitSlope_charpolyRev_matrix_le [Nonempty ι] [IsAlgClosed K] {hp2 : p ≠ 2} {hψ : ∀ x, ‖ψ x‖ = ‖x‖} {ω ω' : (ZMod p)ˣ →* ℤ_[p]ˣ} {T₀ T₀' : K} {k : ℕ} (c : ClassicalData θG ψ U hU vRep hvΔ uu hp2 hψ ω T₀ k) (c' : ClassicalData θG ψ U hU vRep hvΔ uu hp2 hψ ω' T₀' k) (hAL : ∃ B, AtkinLehnerHypothesis ψ 1 k (c.matrix idx) B (c'.matrix idx)) (j : ℕ) : (newtonPolygon₀OfPowerSeries negLogNorm ((c.matrix idx).charpolyRev : PowerSeries K)).unitSlope j ≤ ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-Real.log ‖ψ p‖) : ℝ) : WithBotTop ℝ)
b2_reason: False for every j at or beyond the degree N = card ι * ((k+1) * p^1) of charpolyRev. The polygon of a POLYNOMIAL has unitSlope j = ⊤ for all large j: the polynomial is restricted at every radius, so slopesUnbounded_newtonPolygon₀OfPowerSeries gives some j with σ < unitSlope j for every real σ, and NewtonPolygon₀.unitSlope_mono then forces unitSlope j = ⊤ from that index on (NewtonPolygon₀.unitSlope_cases leaves only ⊤ or ⊥ off a segment, and ⊥ occurs only at j = 0 of the degenerate one-point polygon). ⊤ ≤ ↑σ is false since WithBotTop.coe_ne_top. Corrected form: add the hypothesis (hj : j < Fintype.card ι * ((k + 1) * p ^ 1)); the statement is then exactly the root bound, since charpolyRev has degree N (det ≠ 0 under H1) and its N unit slopes are the -log-norms of its N roots.
counterexample: Any ticket instance with j = Fintype.card ι * ((k+1) * p^1): the left-hand side is ⊤.
